title: Nani’s Secret Stunt Double Career Exposed! 🏆
topic: The finale of Nani's secret life as a legendary scooter racer.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Nani, [beat] explain why there are twenty gold racing trophies [beat] hidden under your knitting basket right now!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Don't be so dramatic, Nix. [beat] A woman needs her hobbies [beat] and a little bit of high-octane adrenaline.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: So that's where [beat] my missing racing fuel went! [beat] You've been siphoning my private collection for months!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Your fuel was [beat] subpar anyway, Jamal. [beat] I needed the premium stuff to clear the gap [beat] on the old drawbridge.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: THE DRAWBRIDGE JUMP? [beat] The police have been looking for 'The Midnight Phantom' [beat] for three weeks, Mom!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: The police are [beat] slow, Rafiq. [beat] I did that jump in a floral cardigan [beat] and didn't even spill my tea.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I found an old magazine! [beat] You were the lead stunt rider [beat] for every action movie in the eighties!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Wait, if you are the legend, [beat] then you're the one who [beat] won the deed to the city racetrack last night?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: I won it [beat] fair and square. [beat] Now Jamal, stop being a snob [beat] or I'll ban your slow cars from my track.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: And all this time [beat] I thought you were [beat] at the library reading boring poetry.

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: I was. [beat] I was reading the technical manual [beat] for a turbocharged nitrous injection system.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Nani is [beat] officially the GOAT. [beat] Nobody in this family [beat] is ever topping this!
